messages:
tom-eng: heads up, deploy-bot flagged textgen-route:v6.0.2 in the late window. Canary p95 spike ~27% and errors ~1.7%. deploy-bot suggests auto-revert. tagging @sam-oncall @rachel-sre

deploy-bot: ALERT -> AUTOREVERT_SUGGESTED. Triggers: p95>210ms (4m), err>1.5% (3m). Canary slice=10%. ACTIONS: AUTOREVERT or MANUAL_ROLLBACK.

ops-bot: snapshot: us-east-2=72% of canary, p95_us=238ms, p95_eu=175ms, overall err=1.7%. runtime-node-gpu-03 showing higher kernel latency. No infra failures.

rachel-sre: prefer manual rollback + pin to avoid autopilot churn for dedicated customers. i'll run the rollback with sam. plan: pause slice, pin to v6.0.1, disable autopilot, run rollback job, monitor 10m.

sam-oncall: taking it. commands:
```
deployctl traffic freeze --release textgen-route:v6.0.2 --slice canary
deployctl release pin --service textgen --version v6.0.1 --reason "rollback: late-window perf regression"
deployctl annotate --release textgen-route:v6.0.2 autopilot_disabled=true
/runbook run rollback-textgen
```

deploy-bot: ACTION_LOG: manual rollback started by sam-oncall; autopilot disabled via annotation.

sam-oncall: rollback job rb-50600 in progress. draining new replicas, shifting traffic to v6.0.1. p95_us back to 158ms after 3m, err 0.4%. monitoring 10m.

ivy-pm: I'll draft a short customer note and a brief internal blurb. Holding external until ops confirms stability.

ops-bot: incident INC-5060077 created for RCA; assigned to eng-runtime and eng-ml. tags: latency, kernel-latency, canary

rachel-sre: 10m stable. closing rb-50600. release notes updated: "Rolled back textgen-route v6.0.2 to v6.0.1 due to canary latency/error increase during late change window; investigation ongoing." locking pin 24h. :white_check_mark:
